UserProfile.title: Hunter Account Profile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated SectionLine KS hunter account profile storing display name and optional callback phone for SMS permission requests.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Hunter full display name inserted into permission texts, letters, notes, and slips.

phone.description: Optional callback phone number shown on mailed landowner letters.

role.description: Crew role assigned to the account.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the hunter account was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private hunter profile documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID. Strictly restricted to the owning authenticated user.
